title: Welcome to your new account
description: Welcome new bank or fintech customers on WhatsApp with next steps after account opening. Includes a link to the app and support number.
notes: Send it right after account approval, while the customer expects contact. Welcome messages tied to an account the user just opened are accepted as utility.

body.text: Welcome to Lumen Bank, {{first_name}}! Your new account is active. Download the app, set up your card and turn on notifications to start. Our team is here if you need help.
